title: PR-body re-bless table omits goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png — 6th re-blessed golden has no cause row
evidence: PR body (lines 59-67): "Exactly **6 crisis-carrying T2 frames**, all the juice scene @65s ... | golden | cause | |---|---| | `goldens/juice/65000ms.png` | non-involved network receded (43,692 px) | | `goldens/a11y_{deutan,protan,tritan}/65000ms.png` | same frame under each CVD mode table (43,688 px) | | `goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png` | same frame, reduced-motion (43,656 px) |" — table enumerates 5 files. git diff 0b2aeb9..HEAD --stat: "goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png | Bin 93968 -> 95879 bytes" (6th PNG modified; verified on disk in the worktree at the round sha).
detail: The diff re-blesses 6 golden PNGs but the cause table documents only 5. Golden discipline (project-context: re-bless 'reviewed like code'; spec: 'Cause-document every re-blessed frame') requires the a11y_scale row.
recommended_fix: Add the missing table row: goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png — same juice@65s crisis frame under the ui-scale a11y mode (the spec's predicted 'a11y_×5@65s' set).

title: PR-body verify claim 'odin test app/render 99/99 (94 + 5 new)' is stale — shipped diff runs 100 tests (+6 new)
evidence: _pr_body_viscomm_crisis_duck.md:123: "| `odin test app/render` | 99/99 (94 + 5 new) |". Live run at the round sha (odin test app/render): "Finished 100 tests in 19.093ms. All tests were successful." Diff adds 6 @(test) procs to app/render/palette_polish_test.odin (base 0b2aeb9: 6 @(test) in that file / 94 in app/render; HEAD: 12 / 100): crisis_desat_factor_purity, crisis_recede_is_byte_identity_when_inert, crisis_recede_reaches_the_calm_register, crisis_involvement_predicates, crisis_packet_involvement_chain, route_tie_inline_load_default_is_pinned.

title: New crisis_packet_involvement_chain test never destroys its loaded Catalogs — violates the package fixture convention and leaks under the tracking allocator
evidence:
app/render/palette_polish_test.odin:388-404: "defer {
	delete(src.node_types)
	delete(src.pipe_tiers)
	delete(src.balance)
	delete(src.packet_types)
	delete(src.demand)
	delete(src.eras)
	delete(src.crises)
 }
 cat: pp.Catalogs
 if e := pp.catalogs_load(&cat, &src); e.file != "" { ... }
 state: pp.Run_State
 pp.run_init(&state, 7, cat.hash, cat.balance.logic_hz)
 defer pp.run_destroy(&state)" — no pp.catalogs_destroy(&cat). Convention: spawn_fx_test.odin has 7 'catalogs_destroy(&cat)' sites, wire_path_test.odin 6, camera_test.odin 1 ('N6 (Perkins r2): the fixture owns its catalog'); proc exists at core/catalog.odin:1466 'catalogs_destroy :: proc(cat: ^Catalogs)'. Live odin test app/render emits ~3900 lines like "+++ leak 896B @ 0xA83807680 [catalog.odin:494:catalogs_load()]".
detail: Every sibling fixture that loads catalogs destroys it; this test deletes only the src byte-slices, leaking the Catalogs internals (~3900 tracking-allocator leak lines), contrary to the ODN-18 leak discipline.
recommended_fix: Add 'defer pp.catalogs_destroy(&cat)' immediately after the successful catalogs_load, matching the spawn_fx_test/wire_path_test fixture convention.
